title: trichopteryx elegantula var. stolziana

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to help lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Stolziana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
